direction_notes: FUS evoked tail EMG and tail movements; 0.3 s sonications gave short-latency EMG, 15 s sonications (with heating) gave short- and long-latency EMG, with higher response rates at the same Isppa.

exposures.label: Deep cerebellar nucleus, mechanical (0.3 s) and mechanothermal (15 s) groups

timing.protocol_description: Mechanical group: 0.3 s sonications every 5 s, 10 repeats per intensity. Mechanothermal group: same pulsing but 15 s sonications with 80 s inter-stimulus interval, 5 repeats per intensity; intensity order randomised within each mouse.

flags.reason: Group sizes of separate experiments (31 behaviour/EMG, 8 MR thermometry, 12 safety); total not stated and overlap not stated.
Isppa calculated as P^2/2rho c with 14% skull attenuation (derating by authors); pressure values themselves not given.
Ispta values read from Table 1 ('Isppa/Ispta'); domain presumed same as Isppa.
Text says 'pulse length = 50 ms'; with PRF 10 Hz and DC 50% this is consistent. Applies to both groups.
Field was calibrated in water with a hydrophone but no pressure values are stated in the text.
